name: design_v2
prompt: Dark 3D game, vertical camera rising up inside a tall cylindrical tunnel whose walls are lined with thousands of small glowing black-and-white archive film frames in rings, like a tomography scan of old films. A translucent jellyfish whose bell is made of glowing particles showing a moving sepia film image, and whose long tentacles are curling strips of 35mm film stock with sprocket holes, swims upward with slow pulses; when a tentacle brushes the wall, the frames there light up and start to play. Soft upward currents of light, a few drifting red ink clouds. Chase camera below and behind the jellyfish, smooth.

name: design_v4
prompt: Dark foggy underwater sewer tunnel, 3D game, chase camera behind a glowing golden creature of light, a squid-like jellyfish made of thousands of shimmering particles with long trailing tentacles. Old black-and-white film clips drift through the fog not as rectangles but as soft glowing clouds of gaussian splats, faces and hands and animals dissolving at the edges like smoke; other clips stretch into long luminous worms of time, the moving image flowing along them. The creature touches a cloud and it pours into its tentacles, which become glowing time worms carrying the moving pictures. A few red corrupted clouds of static crackle in the haze. Organic, no frames, no screens, haunting, deep fog, soft glow bleeding through the haze.

name: design_v5
prompt: LAW: one small golden jellyfish of light, its bell a dome of shimmering particles, its eight tentacles chains of glowing beads, swims away from the camera through a vast dark underwater tunnel; the camera follows low and behind it the whole time, then pulls back wide to reveal more of the tunnel around it. Moving pictures exist only as soft glowing clouds of points with no edges, never as rectangles or screens: large drifting smoke-clouds showing old black-and-white film footage, a horse running, a face, a hand, playing inside the haze. The tunnel forks around a dark rock pillar into two passages. FLOW: a deep-sea anglerfish, a huge black shape made of sparse dim particles, hangs in the right passage with a glowing lure that also shows a tiny film; a school of silver fish made of flecks scatters as the jellyfish passes; a long ribbon eel whose body is a chain of small film-clouds glides alongside; streams of marine snow flow in a spiralling current; a second, cyan jellyfish of light swims in the distance. Dark teal fog, only the films and creatures give light, red grain clouds of corruption drift near the walls. Slow, fluid, haunting.
